description: This file declares functions and macros for managing a specific PCIe endpoint device, including clock control, GPIO management, and interrupt configuration, for the Intel SmartPHY DSL driver in a Linux kernel environment.

methods.name: dc_ep_clkod_disable
methods.description: Disables the clock override for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_init
methods.description: Initializes the interrupt control unit for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_disable
methods.description: Disables the interrupt control unit.

methods.name: dc_ep_assert_device
methods.description: Asserts (activates) the device using specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_deassert_device
methods.description: Deasserts (deactivates) the device using specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_reset_device
methods.description: Resets the device with given bits, returning status.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_on
methods.description: Turns on the clock for the device with given bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_off
methods.description: Turns off the clock for the device with given bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_set
methods.description: Sets the system and peripheral clock frequencies.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_get
methods.description: Retrieves current system and peripheral clock frequencies.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_dir
methods.description: Sets the direction for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_set
methods.description: Sets the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_get
methods.description: Reads the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: dc_ep_pinmux_set
methods.description: Configures pin multiplexing for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_pinmux_get
methods.description: Retrieves current pin multiplexing configuration.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_pupd_set
methods.description: Sets pull-up/pull-down configuration for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_od_set
methods.description: Configures open-drain mode for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_src_set
methods.description: Sets source for GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_dcc_set
methods.description: Sets drive control on a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_dis_intr
methods.description: Disables interrupts for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_en_intr
methods.description: Enables interrupts for the PCIe endpoint.
